adapters.tunTimeout: The tunnel interface did not come up. The start was cancelled to prevent a traffic leak.
adapters.aliasExhausted: Could not pick a name for the TUN adapter: “Ethernet 5” … “Ethernet 12” and “VPNTE-TUN” are all taken by other network connections. Rename or remove the unused connections and try again.
adapters.foreignTunConflict: Another system tunnel is already active. Turn off its TUN mode and connect again.
